task.title: Update header nav for better UX
task.description:
Make the "deleted tasks: hidden" button and Publishing button an actual UI toggle:
These controls shouldn't be a text button, but a nicely designed toggle switch. Text "Show/Hide Deleted" and "Publish/Push" followed by the toggle. So e.g. when Deleted tasks are being shown, the text reads "Hide Deleted", and when auto publishing is turned off that text reads "Publish".

It also doesn't belong in the same nav control as the Board and Statuses link. For one, when you're on the Statuses page, the button disappears, which moves the position of the Board link as well - bad UI experience with nav links not in consistent positions.
So: move "Board" and "Statuses" links to be left-aligned in the top nav, next to the "Workbook Board" header.
Keep the Deleted and Publishing toggles right-aligned.
